modules.module_title: Take Charge of the Shift from sizing machine operator

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
check for the necessary items like chalk, pen knife etc.
meet the previous shift sizer, discuss with him/ her regarding the issues faced by them with respect to the quality, production, spare, safety or any other specific instruction etc.
check the condition of the running beams, machine, performance of the yarn running on machine
check whether all the stop motions are in good working condition
take job cards for the next programs from the your superior
check availability of the warped beams & the empty sizing beams required for the next programs
check the quality of the warped beams for the damages, particularly near the flanges
check the cleanliness of the machines & other work areas

check whether any spare/raw material/ tool /any other material is thrown under the machines or in the other work areas. Question the previous shift sizer for any deviation in the above and should bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her shift superior as well that of the previous shift as well.
take over the shift to the outgoing sizer i.e. shift operator in a proper manner

modules.module_title: Handing over the Shift to sizing machine operator

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming sizer in a proper manner & get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot

report to his/ her shift superiors as well as that of the incoming shift, in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for work. In that case, the shift has to be properly handed over to the incoming shift superior & get clearance from him/ her before leaving the work spot

report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his/ her shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superiors

pcs.pc_description: clean the sizing creel & the sizing machine after the run out of the previous program.
bring the warped beams for the next set to the sizing machine from the warping area
creel the warped beams in the sizing creel as instructed
knot the ends of the creeled warp beams with that of the old warp sheet from the previous set.
put tape on the warp sheet so as to enable the lease to be applied
check with supervisor whether single sow box or double sow box is to be used for the next set
pull warp sheet from the creeled warping beam according to the requirement of the sow box/ sow boxes,
clean the sow box/ sow boxes before the knots reach the sow box/ sow boxes
switch on, size pump, sow box steam valve, squeeze roller pressure valve, moisture control etc. once the size is filled in the sow box/ sow boxes
activate impregnating rollers
ensure that the size is not boiled in excess than required avoid splash in the warp sheet which may result in size patches
check the viscosity & refractometer reading for the size in the sow box/ sow boxes.
check the drying cylinders temperature
apply lease as advised
mend the lappers
activate hydraulic rollers when the machine is running to ensure the required pressure & size pick up
ensure that no space is left near the flanges on both sides
ensure that no warp thread is overlapped, particularly near the flanges on both sides
ensure that the leasing area & comb area are free from waste.
ensure that moisture controller & temperature controller are properly functioning.
weigh each & every beam on completion and check the size pick up
correct the migration of ends
note down the lapper details, migration details etc. in the performance log note book.
check the Stretch Control
paste the gum tape on the beams 2-3 metres before the end of each warp sheet after sizing
paste another tap on the beam after the completion of the beam
write following details on the beam ticket and paste it on the flange after the completion of beam:- a) Yarn Count, b) Set No., c) Beam No., d) Total Ends, e) Beam Metres

note the following set details in the sizing production register after the completion of the Set:-a) Yarn Count, b) Set No., c) Beam No., d) Total Ends, e) Beam Metres, f) Size Pick Up, g) No. Of Lappers
keep the lease rope ready so as to apply the lease, when required
Do not touch the machine when it is running.
drench the gum tape in water so that it doesn't peel off easily.
check with supervisor for the continuous use of the size in the sow box/sow boxes or for the collection of the same in can/ cans
give preference to safety, should not enter the area where he/ she is not allowed & should not do a job in which training has not being given
ensure that no raw material/ cloth/ spare/ tool / any other material is thrown under/ near the machines or in the other work areas.
run the sizing machine at optimum speed or as advised by supervisor
check the reasons for the frequent breakages, correct the same if possible otherwise report it to the supervisor
report immediately to supervisor for any machine faults
